% Pattern: proof/amsthm/amsart. A theorem, then two paragraphs of remarks
% about it, then its proof, with no environment between.
% seen in the gold pilot (set X)
% want thm-1 statement/theorem 1 status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=thm-1
\documentclass{amsart}
\newtheorem{thm}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\begin{thm} Each tree with $n$ vertices has $n-1$ edges. \end{thm}

Let us make a few remarks about this result before turning to the proof. The
bound is sharp for paths, and the converse holds for connected graphs.

A forest with $c$ components has $n-c$ edges, by the same count, and so the
theorem is the case $c=1$.

\begin{proof} Remove a leaf and use induction. \end{proof}
\end{document}
